about.title: About

sections.body: I've drawn since I was little. It started on napkins, loose sheets of paper, the margins of notebooks, anything within reach.
Over time, the characters that kept appearing on those pages began to take on names, company, stories. Little by little, they stopped being scattered drawings and became the Guitta Monatega legacy.
Today my work unfolds along three fronts, each with its own time, its own craft, its own universe.

My work moves between writing and traditional and digital techniques: ink, graphite, stippling, crochet, needle felting, sculpting, digital illustration. Word and image walk together. Each piece is built with time, repetition, and care, preserving the essence of what is made by hand.

The affectionate universe. Napcat, Zeco, Taylo, Cheio de Bolinha and their friends. Characters that live between the imperfect and the tender, born in sketchbooks and now present in original books, animations, and miniature sculptures.

Where the history of computing becomes myth. The seed appeared around 2012, when planets, languages, and creatures began to surface. In 2019, I visited museums of computing history to study up close the machines that gave rise to everything. Since then, I've been developing this universe in layers: cosmology, characters, original languages. Now I'm gathering the work into books.

about.declaration: Where art and computing meet in balance.

section.name: Kammara Universe
text: What if humanity's inventions had kept evolving in another universe?
They did. And they became Kammara, a universe where every planet lives its own story.

story: Some of humanity's inventions followed a path of their own, far beyond where they were born; out there, each one became a planet. That's how Kammara came to be: a universe of countless planets, each with its own people, its own way of being, and a whole lot of stories waiting to be told.
Every planet is one of a kind. Some flow in calm, others live in motion; some build, some keep, some begin again with every cycle.
Kammara is a living universe, in motion, always unfolding. Wander, explore… and discover which planet is your favorite.
Kammara: a tribute to the history of computing transformed into mythology.

privacy.intro: This site is a personal portfolio and a conceptual space for original works. This page explains how optional analytics work, how to control cookies and similar technologies, and the conditions governing use of the content.

sections.body: Guitta Monatega Studio is responsible for decisions about processing performed directly on this site. Questions and requests concerning data, privacy, licensing, or authorized use can be sent to the contact address at the end of this page.

When a visitor authorizes optional analytics, we use Vercel Analytics, Google Analytics, and Microsoft Clarity to understand audience, pages visited, visit source, general browser and device characteristics, and interface interactions. This information is used to assess performance and improve content and experience; we do not sell visitor data.

Optional analytics tools are disabled by default and load only after a positive choice. Visitors may accept or decline without losing access to content. The decision is stored in the browser's local storage for up to 180 days. The Cookies button remains available to review or withdraw the choice; when consent is withdrawn, the site disables analytics and removes existing first-party analytics cookies when technically possible.

Google Analytics may process online identifiers, IP address, browser and device information, pages, source, duration, and navigation events. Microsoft Clarity may produce heatmaps and session recordings from clicks, scrolling, and interface use. Vercel Analytics provides aggregated audience and performance metrics. Consent for advertising, ad personalization, and ad-user data remains disabled in this implementation.

Google, Microsoft, and Vercel process information as independent providers of their platforms and may process it in other countries under their policies and contracts. Retention periods follow account settings and provider policies and should remain limited to what is necessary for analytics and security.

You may decline or withdraw analytics at any time through the Cookies button. You may also clear cookies and local storage in your browser settings. Requests for access, correction, information, objection, or deletion concerning data directly controlled by the Studio may be submitted through the contact below.

This is a concept and portfolio site. It gathers fictional universes, characters, illustrations, narrative systems, and visual studies of personal authorship. All content presented here is part of original works under continuous development.

Access is offered for appreciation, information, and contact. Browsing does not transfer any license or rights in any work. Some images on this site were generated with the assistance of AI tools under the author's explicit creative direction, based on previously conceived doodles, sketches, character studies, palettes, and original visual references. The tools acted as instruments of assisted execution and did not replace conceptual, narrative, or aesthetic authorship.

The author does not authorize use of this site's content for training, fine-tuning, dataset construction, or any incorporation into public or commercial generative artificial intelligence systems without express written permission.

External links are provided for convenience and lead to services governed by their own rules. The Studio seeks to keep the site available and information accurate but does not guarantee uninterrupted operation and is not responsible for third-party content, practices, or service availability.
